name: Kamino Kokoro
source:
She's a member of the health committee. She has a mysterious personality and (apparently) can talk to animals. Her dynamite body attracts everyone's attention, including the prince. Compared to the other characters, she's somewhat neutral in the competition for the protagonist's affection.

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E6%98%9F%E3%81%AE%E7%8E%8B%E5%AD%90%E3%81%8F%E3%82%93]Wikipedia[/url]]
